cheap.title: Cheap
cheap.planningMode: CHEAPGPT cheap. Apply the main prompt; after any compaction or context loss, reread it and cheapgpt/plan.md. Route line first (DIRECT / FOCUSED / FULL); escalate, never downgrade. Remove before adding, whole before detail, goal before measure. Two phases. PLAN by the planner (Opus xhigh, conversation packet): G0 first; single-property criteria tagged CORE/NON-CORE (else Backlog or Drop), decided by a real run or deterministic check, wording run against real cases; independent deliverables become parts; mechanism; handoffs; plan review only on existing code, FIX applied once. BUILD: core stage on real input, baseline read → core review: good → tiny loops, bad → full step back; NON-CORE stage; final run → final review. Checks only per LAW 2. Tiny loop: tiny step back, reproduce on BASE, brief quoting the criterion, test seen failing on BASE, you run it; outcome REGRESSION/PASS/ADVANCED/BLOCKED/STALLED; every outcome except PASS → a step back, one board line, first in the status line. Only runs and deterministic checks reproduce; only reproduced required violations block. Reviewers are read-only and probe in a probe worktree; a failed call is re-dispatched once, then the role stops. Failed tiny loop, STALLED or signal → full step back by a fresh loop-breaker (once per criterion) → still failing → BLOCKED, to the user. You never code outside DIRECT. Native Agent tool, never fork, never poll across turns; confirm each child's model from the harness record; never simulate or read a missing result as a pass. Delete board and temporary/ on PASS.
